summary: Etsy x-api-key is composed as keystring:shared_secret on the wire, and every response's x-remaining-today/x-limit-per-day is observed for the local budget guard. Shared-secret templates retain placeholder error classification with value-free setup guidance.
reason: Etsy requires keystring:shared_secret since 2026-02-09 and publishes its daily quota only in response headers. The generated client sent the bare key and had no quota memory. Edits are marked etsy-ext in client.go (composition at the x-api-key header, ObserveEtsyQuota after each response, credential masking); helpers live in etsy_* files because internal/cliutil is generator-reserved.
